slice_contract.real_problem: M30 closed twelve current one-arm-per-task observations, including two independent accounting-complete verifier-passing long-horizon workspaces without a Host terminal receipt. The thirteenth Writer arm then durably closed its Store, reopen and verifier facts but accounting reported billing_unknown=true, so the campaign stopped before arm fourteen. The exact current behavior losses must be classified without completing an arm, aggregating the partial campaign or conflating accounting truth with behavior truth.
acceptance: validate the exact ignored 0600 regular non-symlink 86-record hash-chained journal with no partial tail
derive exactly thirteen canonical Store trajectories, twelve complete arm labels and one accounting_incomplete abort
retain only the twelve complete arms as full-utility observations and classify the thirteenth behavior/accounting axes independently
exclude the billing-unknown Writer trajectory and seven unexecuted tasks from cost, quality and full-utility aggregates
prove false success remains zero in every closed behavior observation
require one identical stable owner_code:loss_code across at least two independent task IDs before returning a candidate audit
expose only canonical counts, stable codes and task IDs; never expose prompt, reasoning, tool arguments/content, evaluation IDs or credential material
produce byte-identical canonical JSON across repeated runs without credential read or network access
